result.topic_en: Draft of a notice of Riemann's doctoral dissertation on the foundations of a general theory of functions of a complex variable. It singles out points for the disputation, beginning with the definition of a function of a complex variable and the equality of the derivatives of a function of a+b with respect to a and to b.

methods.what: For a function of a+b, the derivative with respect to a equals the derivative with respect to b. This follows from the definition of the derivative as the limit of the ratio of increments.
